entities.summary: John Bright (1908–1995) was an American biblical scholar and the author of several books, including the influential A History of Israel (1959), currently in its fourth edition (2000). He was closely associated with the American school of biblical criticism pioneered by William F. Albright, which sought to marry archaeology to a defense of the reliability of the Bible, especially the earlier books of the Old Testament. John Bright was a theologians & scholars from Chattanooga (1908-09-25, Chattanooga–1995-03-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
